meta.title: 肩膀基础示范：单肩提沉、双肩交替
meta.topic: 舞蹈教学 · 肩膀基础

scenes.context: 肩膀基础示范第一步：单肩提沉，然后是双肩交替。先单个肩膀提起来再沉下去。语域：舞蹈教学，动作口令。
sentences: 肩膀基础示范：单肩提沉。
Basic shoulder demo: lift one shoulder, then drop it.
lift and drop（提沉）
然后是双肩交替。
Then alternate both shoulders.
alternate both shoulders（双肩交替）
动作要干脆，不拖泥带水。
The moves should be crisp, not sloppy.
crisp and clean（干脆）
paraphrase: 提沉 → lift and drop / raise and lower
lift and drop · raise and lower
干脆 → crisp / sharp and clean
scenes.speak: Basic shoulder demo: lift one shoulder, then drop it. Then alternate both shoulders. The moves should be crisp, not sloppy.

scenes.context: 继续示范：绕肩画圆，活动肩关节。肩关节转起来，保持放松。语域：舞蹈教学，动作口令。
sentences: 继续示范：绕肩画圆，活动肩关节。
Continuing the demo: circle the shoulders to mobilize the joint.
mobilize the joint（活动关节）
肩关节转起来，幅度不用大。
Roll the shoulder joint — no need for a big range.
roll the joint（转动关节）
保持放松，感受发力。
Stay relaxed and feel the engagement.
feel the engagement（感受发力）
paraphrase: 绕肩 → circle the shoulders / roll the shoulders
活动关节 → mobilize the joint / loosen the joint
scenes.speak: Continuing the demo: circle the shoulders to mobilize the joint. Roll the shoulder joint — no need for a big range. Stay relaxed and feel the engagement.

scenes.title_cn: 前后顶肩 + 爆发发力
scenes.context: 更多动作变化：前后顶肩、爆发发力。这个集合里你会几个？收尾互动。语域：舞蹈教学，进阶+收尾。
sentences: 更多动作变化：前后顶肩、爆发发力。
More variations: shoulder thrusts forward and back with explosive power.
shoulder thrusts（顶肩）
爆发发力，动作要弹出。
Fire with explosive power — the moves should snap.
snap（弹出）
这个合集里，你会几个？
How many of these moves can you do?
how many can you do（你会几个）
paraphrase: 顶肩 → shoulder thrust / push the shoulder
爆发发力 → explosive power / snap out the move
scenes.speak: More variations: shoulder thrusts forward and back with explosive power. Fire with explosive power — the moves should snap. How many of these moves can you do?

practice: Basic shoulder demo: lift one shoulder, then drop it.
Circle the shoulders to mobilize the joint.
Shoulder thrusts forward and back with explosive power.
How many of these moves can you do?
pitfalls: Lift one shoulder, then drop it.
Draw a circle with the shoulder.
Circle the shoulders to mobilize the joint.
「绕肩画圆」用 circle / roll the shoulders。
The moves should be crisp, not sloppy.
shifts: 用 lift and drop（提沉）、circle / roll（绕/转）、thrusts（顶）
用 engagement（发力）、explosive power（爆发）、snap（弹出）
用 crisp（干脆）、sloppy（拖泥带水）、loosen（放松）
